decision_rule.text: Require the entire measured whole panel and controls valid, complete, exact signed/projected equality and true L2. For each round sum wall across144 fixed strata separately per alias. Primary ratio is mean baseline alias totals divided by mean active alias totals. Use10000 paired round-block bootstrap draws. Compare lower95percent ratio limit to max(1.10, baseline-AA and active-AA upper95percent larger/smaller ratio limits). Passing is a finite-panel cost signature only. Upper limit<=1 or complete precise failure of threshold is no qualifying gain; overlapping/AA/censoring/insufficient precision is inconclusive. Residual batches diagnose exact certificates/counters and separately retained panel cost; no additional confirmatory tests.
